description: Native 96x64 transparent pixel-art prop sheet with exactly TWO separate hanging dungeon props, each complete and separated by clear transparent space. LEFT side centered near x20: one narrow dark forged-iron vertical hanging chain, about 7 pixels wide and 48 pixels tall. Small top ceiling anchor, clear alternation of face-on oval links and thin edge-on links with crisp 1-pixel joints, 4-5 regularly spaced links, no crossed knots, ending in a complete closed bottom link. Tiny warm rust marks, restrained cool iron highlights. RIGHT side centered near x64: one narrow vertical dark-plum cloth pennant, about 30 pixels wide and 48 pixels tall, with a short dark metal horizontal rod and two tiny mounting clips at top, complete pointed V-bottom. Cloth is flat-front side-view, dark restrained plum with one simple fold shadow and a thin muted edge. In the middle one centered simplified crowned skull crest in desaturated muted warm rose-gold, just a readable flat heraldic silhouette and two dark eye holes, no facial portrait or avatar. Crest is small, about 12 pixels wide, subordinate to game actors. All outlines and silhouettes complete, generous native transparent padding on every side. Both props have crisp chunky connected clusters, top-left lighting, low detail. NO walls, NO room, NO torches, NO floor, NO UI frames, NO text, NO anti-aliasing, NO shine or bright gold, NO extra items. The supplied Rattlebones image guides native pixel rendering discipline only; do not copy his body or royal cape.

style_image.usage_description: Actual current Rattlebones golden sprite: crisp native contour and economical flat material shading only. Two small hanging architecture props, not a character. Preserve dark iron, plum fabric and muted rose-gold crest colors instead of copying his palette.

palette_name: Dungeon Matcher hanging-prop iron, quiet plum cloth and muted crest
